name: Handa Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
summary: Handa Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a specialty pharmaceutical company, focuses on the development of drugs for various diseases in the United States. The company offers ONCORE, a proprietary drug delivery technology that was developed to improve the patient compliance and safety of the tyrosine kinase inhibitor of oncology drugs; Phyrago, an oral kinase inhibitor used to treat chronic myeloid leukemia and acute lymphoblastic leukemia; Tascenso ODT for the treatment of multiple sclerosis; and HND-033, HND-039, and HND-027 for oncology diseases.
